defect_found.consequence: a caller-supplied count of 100000 would either allocate absurdly or walk past the provided array
defect_found.description: compression_count had an explicit limit of 8 but cipher_count, group_count and signature_count were passed straight to calloc and to NSS loops with no bound at all

fix: NECKO_TLS_MAX_ITEMS (512) gates cipher, group and signature counts; NECKO_TLS_MAX_COMPRESSION (8) keeps the previous limit; a non-zero count with a null array is also refused
notes: the real profile uses the three suites this NSS build implements and completes a handshake plus HTTP exchange
the oversized cases are refused before any NSS call, so the peer sees only an EOF, never a request
